production.updatesPaused: Production commands are paused until the live change stream is current. You can still refresh this board manually.
production.pendingDescription: These ready orders arrived outside the started plan. A manager must explicitly add each one to the live run.
production.placementNoRun: No production run is active. Start an accepted schedule before retrying this order.
production.placementNotAttempted: This order has not been added to the live run. A manager can preview the earliest safe placement.
production.placementMultipleRuns: More than one production run is active. Open the intended run before retrying placement.
production.anotherRunDescription: Open that run to confirm its overtime proposal, or retry automatic placement into this queue.
production.overtimeDetail: This exact queue proposal adds {{minutes}} minutes and finishes at {{finish}}.
production.managerApproval: Owner or administrator approval is required.
production.noAcceptedBatchesDescription: Start an accepted schedule to populate the floor board.
production.assignMachinesDescription: Batch {{batch}} needs {{weight, number}} lb of active compatible capacity. Saving replaces the full machine set for this stage.
production.insufficientCapacity: The server will reject capacity below the batch demand.
production.pulseStillRunning: The planned pulse is still running.
production.completeEarlyDescription: {{stage}} has run for {{elapsed}} of its {{planned}} planned pulse. {{remaining}} remains.
production.startIfReady: Start now if the batch is physically ready.
production.earlyConfirmation: Completing before the planned pulse ends requires confirmation.
production.stageNeedsMachinesDetail: Assign enough active compatible machines before starting this stage.
production.stagePreviousIncompleteDetail: Complete the previous stage for this batch before starting this one.
production.stageKindActiveDetail: Another batch is active in this stage. Complete it before starting this batch.
production.stageMachineOverlapDetail: One or more assigned machines are already in use. Choose free compatible machines.
production.stageRunNotStartedDetail: Start the accepted production run before starting this batch.
production.earlierThanPlanned: This stage is earlier than planned.
production.earlyStartDescription: It is planned for {{time}}, {{remaining}} from now. Start only if the batch is physically ready. The original plan will not change.
production.canCompleteAfterConfirmation: {{stage}} can be completed early after confirmation.
production.selectMachine: Select at least one active machine for this stage.
production.chooseMutableBatch: Choose a mutable queued batch for exact placement.
production.batchMissing: The selected batch is no longer on this board.
production.floorReady: Batch {{batch}} progress is ready to confirm.

errors.boardLoadFailed: The production board could not be refreshed. Current floor data may be outdated; check your connection and refresh.
errors.boardMissing: This production run no longer has an active board. Return to Schedule or History and open a current run.
errors.runClosed: This production run is complete or its shift is closed. The board is now read-only.
errors.runNotStarted: This production run has not started yet. Start its accepted schedule before recording floor work.
errors.recordChanged: Production changed while this action was open. The board has been refreshed; review the current stage, batch, and order before acting again.
errors.stageMissing: This stage is no longer on the current board. Review the refreshed batch before continuing.
errors.plannedStartNotReached: This stage is not scheduled to start yet. Wait for its planned start or use the early-start confirmation shown by Processor.
errors.pulseBoundaryNotReached: This stage has not reached its planned pulse boundary. Wait for the boundary or use the early-completion confirmation shown by Processor.
errors.confirmationStale: This confirmation expired because production changed. Review the refreshed stage and request a new confirmation.
errors.machineMissing: A selected machine no longer exists. Review the active machine list and choose again.
errors.machineUnavailable: A selected machine is inactive or unavailable. Choose an active machine that is free for this stage.
errors.machineDuplicated: A machine cannot be assigned to two active stage runs at the same time. Review the other active batches and choose again.
errors.machineWrongStage: A selected machine is not approved for this production stage. Choose a compatible machine.
errors.machineCapacity: The selected machines do not provide enough capacity for this batch. Add compatible active machines before assigning.
errors.batchMissing: This batch is no longer on the current board. Review the refreshed production run.
errors.alreadyFrozen: This batch is already frozen; no change was needed.
errors.alreadyMutable: This batch is already mutable; no change was needed.
errors.freezeForbidden: This batch cannot be frozen in its current state. Only eligible queued work can be frozen.
errors.unfreezeForbidden: This batch cannot be made mutable after production has started or membership became immutable.
errors.membershipImmutable: This batch has started, so normal membership changes are no longer allowed. Use Order control for a floor exception.
errors.orderAlreadyPlaced: This order is already assigned to production. Review its current batch before taking another placement action.
errors.orderNotEligible: This order is not eligible for production. Complete intake and resolve its eligibility before placing it.
errors.orderNotReady: This order is not ready for this production run. Refresh and review its current state.
errors.hardCapacity: This whole order would exceed the selected batch's hard pulse capacity. Choose a batch with enough remaining capacity.
errors.noMutableBatch: No queued mutable batch can receive this whole order. Review batch state and hard capacity before trying again.
errors.placementForbidden: This placement is not allowed for the order or batch in its current state. Review the refreshed board.
errors.overtimeRequired: This order would finish after the shift. Review and confirm the overtime estimate before placing it.
errors.overtimeStale: The overtime estimate changed. Review the refreshed completion time and request a new confirmation.
errors.floorPreviewFailed: LPMS could not verify the proposed floor progress. No reconciliation was submitted; review the refreshed batch.
errors.floorCommitUnknown: LPMS could not confirm the reconciliation result. Refresh and verify the batch's recorded stage before trying again.
errors.actionUnknown: Processor could not confirm the action result. The board was refreshed; verify the current floor state before trying again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot complete this production action. Ask an owner or administrator for access.
errors.unavailable: The production board cannot reach the service. Check your connection and refresh.
errors.invalidResponse: The production service returned board data that Processor could not read. Refresh before continuing.

floorProgress.title: Record floor progress
floorProgress.description: Use this when the board is behind what physically happened. Planned times stay unchanged, and missed event times remain unrecorded.
floorProgress.alreadyFinished: This batch is already recorded as finished.
floorProgress.machineHelp: Select the machines this batch is using now. Historical machine use stays unrecorded.
floorProgress.noMachinesDescription: Add or activate a compatible machine before recording this stage as active.
floorProgress.notePlaceholder: Anything the next operator should know
floorProgress.otherNoteRequired: Add a short note when the reason is Something else.
floorProgress.readyDescription: The server rechecked queue v{{queue}}, Batch {{batch}}, and all four stage versions. Confirm to make this the floor record.
floorProgress.noChanges: No stage changes will be recorded.
floorProgress.closeRun: Because this is the last unfinished batch, the production run and shift will close.
